A second narrow ribbon of the same gossamer silk drifts across her chest, and the same silk may stream from her shoulders or behind her. FORBIDDEN: gowns, dresses, bodices, corsets, skirts, capes, cloaks, armour, straps, harnesses, thick or opaque cloth, velvet, brocade, layered drapery. The silhouette stays bare and uncluttered — the sensuality comes from skin and the single band of silk, never from clothing. No explicit nudity: no visible breasts or nipples, no buttocks or genitals; the chest ribbon and the hip band always cover those areas. Bare skin of the shoulders, arms, back, waist, hips and legs is expected and desired; the fabric must read as a whisper of silk, not as clothing.
